# agentic-assistant

An AI assistant that acts inside your apps with the user's own permissions.

Keywords: assistant,ai,agent,tools,mcp,sdk,side-panel,approvals,eu,model-port.

- SDK: import { runAssistant, ToolRegistry, createPrincipal } from "agentic-assistant".
- CLI: agentic-assistant chat --tools <mcp-url> --scope <s> --tool-scope <s> "message". MCP server: agentic-assistant mcp.
- Panel: import { AssistantPanel } from "agentic-assistant/react"; import "agentic-assistant/react.css".
- Test provider: import { ScriptedProvider } from "agentic-assistant/testing".

## Docs
